en.title: RuPaul's Drag Race Snags Season 19 Renewal; All Stars 12 Also Ordered
en.summary: The werkroom doors are staying open! Both the flagship series and its All Stars counterpart have officially secured new seasons, much to the delight of devoted fans worldwide.
en.body:
The reign of **RuPaul's Drag Race** is far from over. In a move that will undoubtedly send ripples of excitement through the global fandom, both the flagship competition series and its beloved spin-off, **RuPaul's Drag Race All Stars**, have been officially renewed. **MTV** has greenlit **RuPaul's Drag Race** for a landmark Season 19, while **Paramount+** has ordered Season 12 of **RuPaul's Drag Race All Stars**. This dual renewal ensures that fans will continue to witness the creativity, drama, and undeniable talent that has made the franchise a cornerstone of reality television.

The 18th season of **RuPaul's Drag Race** recently crowned its winner, with the Orlando-based queen **Myki Meeks** taking home the coveted title of America's Next Drag Superstar. The season finale, which saw **Nini Coco** and her iconic talking purse come in a very close second, aired on April 17, 2026. The quick turnaround for renewals underscores the show's consistent performance and its vital role in the programming schedules of its respective networks.

## The Franchise Lives On

For viewers who live and breathe for the weekly challenges, the runway reveals, and the inevitable lip-syncs for your life, these renewals are more than just good news—they are a confirmation of the show's cultural impact. **RuPaul's Drag Race** has consistently delivered compelling narratives, from the fierce competition among queens to the personal journeys of self-discovery and empowerment. The consistent demand for new seasons, despite the evolving landscape of television, speaks volumes about the show's ability to connect with its audience on a deeply emotional and entertaining level. The continued presence of **RuPaul's Drag Race: Untucked** alongside the main series on MTV also guarantees that the behind-the-scenes drama and sisterhood moments will continue to be a vital part of the viewing experience.

## What Fans Can Expect

While specific premiere dates for **RuPaul's Drag Race** Season 19 and **RuPaul's Drag Race All Stars** Season 12 have not yet been announced, the renewals themselves provide immense anticipation. Fans can expect the signature blend of high-stakes challenges, stunning fashion, and the inimitable judging panel led by **RuPaul Charles**. The **All Stars** season, in particular, always brings a unique dynamic as returning fan favorites battle for a chance at ultimate redemption and a place in the Drag Race Hall of Fame. The network's commitment to both series suggests a long-term strategy to keep the franchise at the forefront of entertainment, catering to both established viewers and new audiences discovering the magic of drag.

## What's Next

With two new seasons on the horizon, the **RuPaul's Drag Race** universe is set to expand further. Keep an eye on **MTV** and **Paramount+** for official announcements regarding casting, premiere dates, and any potential twists that **RuPaul** might have in store for the upcoming installments. The race to become the next drag superstar is officially on, again.

content_raw: MTV and Paramount+ have good news for RuPaul's Drag Race and RuPaul's Drag Race All Stars: shantay, you both stay!
